        return 0
    
    max_gap = 0
    current_gap = 1

        if a[i] - a[i-1] > 1:

            current_gap = 1
        else:
            current_gap += 1
    
    max_gap = max(max_gap, current_gap)
    
    return max(0, n - max_gap - 1)
